verdict.rationale: LiteLLM ships an official Python SDK (the `completion()` interface) that mirrors the OpenAI SDK format across 100+ providers, letting AI-native developers build without learning per-provider APIs; this is corroborated by community Show HN feedback praising it for standardizing APIs and confirming SDK parity for streaming/function-calling. Missing for 10: evidence of official SDKs in other languages (e.g., JS/TS) and independent benchmarking of SDK completeness beyond community praise.
